host: the AI tool the read was made in, for example Claude or ChatGPT
access_level: read, or read and write, as the connection reports it; empty if it did not say

shop.theme: the main theme's name and version if the read returned them, else empty
markets: countries or markets the read returned, one string each

tags: each tag as returned, one string each; empty list when none
products.category: the full Shopify product category, as returned

not_returned: each field above the read did not return, by name
